title: Minimal data set for pipette decontamination.
author: Sang Hyuk Lee
license_note: figshare article detail endpoint license.name: CC BY 4.0

steps.title: Contaminate pipette tips
steps.instruction: Expose all pipette tips (control and experimental) to DNA extracts of Aeromonas hydrophila (ATCC‑23211) to create contaminated samples.

steps.title: Detergent wash and steam
steps.instruction: Decontaminate tips by washing with 2.5 % Alconox® solution followed by steam decontamination.

substeps.instruction: Immerse tips in 2.5 % Alconox® solution (duration not specified).

steps.title: Ozone vapor at low concentration
steps.instruction: Expose contaminated tips to ozone vapor delivering a total dose of 250 PPM × minute.

steps.title: Ozone vapor at high concentration
steps.instruction: Expose contaminated tips to ozone vapor delivering a total dose of 14 400 PPM × minute.

steps.title: Cold atmospheric plasma exposure
steps.instruction: Place tips inverted (tip end nearer the plasma flame) and expose to cold atmospheric plasma (CAP) for 1 minute.
